title: Custodian Control
subtitle: Test your understanding of Custodian Control — how parasitic realm managers contain, monitor, and harvest the human population inside a closed planetary system.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Full liberation from Custodian Control requires the deliberate severing of the Three Strings of Enslavement: Perceived Knowledge, Religion, and Finance. Exposing the Cestui Que Vie Bond and withdrawing consent under the Sovereign Accord removes the authority of the enclosure. Eliminating fluoridated water and toxic pharmaceutical inputs decalcifies the pineal gland and restores endogenous DMT production.

questions.question: How long ago did the Custodians establish their administrative matrix over the physical plane?

options.label: A
options.text: Custodian governance began exactly 1,666 years ago with the creation of the birth certificate bond.
options.rationale: That number belongs to the Cestui Que Vie bond, not the origin of total governance over the physical plane.

options.label: B
options.text: The Custodians assumed total governance over the physical plane roughly 150,000 years ago.
options.rationale: Parasitic realm managers assumed total governance over the physical plane roughly 150,000 years ago and established the overarching operational framework.

options.label: C
options.text: Total governance of the physical plane began roughly 2,000 years ago alongside the inserted fabricated history.
options.rationale: Up to two thousand years of fabricated history were inserted later to hide resets, long after the original takeover.

options.label: D
options.text: The administrative matrix over the physical plane was established nearly 500,000 years ago.
options.rationale: The takeover of the physical plane is placed at roughly 150,000 years ago, not a half-million-year mark.

questions.hint: Focus on the timeline that describes the initial transition to total governance of the physical plane.

questions.question: What is the primary function of the Cestui Que Vie 1666 Birth Certificate Bond?

options.label: A
options.text: It establishes a record of lineage so hereditary property rights can pass to descendants, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The maritime system treats land as corporate real estate and the living being as collateral, not as a holder of hereditary title.

options.label: B
options.text: It provides a valid identity so a living person can participate in democratic elections, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Registration converts the living soul into a corporate asset, and electoral participation is only a surface use of that fiction.

options.label: C
options.text: It guarantees social security benefits to the registered person upon reaching maturity, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The bond is built for extraction and liquidation into parasitic financial coffers, not for the benefit of the living human.

options.label: D
options.text: A fraudulent maritime financial trust monetizes a living human soul as a corporate fiction and collateral asset.
options.rationale: The Cestui Que Vie Bond is a fraudulent maritime financial trust established upon birth registration that monetizes a living human soul as a corporate fiction and collateral asset.

questions.hint: Consider the relationship between maritime legal capture and the conversion of people into commodities.

questions.question: By what specific mechanism do Custodians avoid direct field conflict with the Sovereign Accord?

options.label: A

options.rationale: A self-sustaining harmonic field cannot be overridden from outside, so the law is bypassed through local choice rather than blocked.

options.label: B
options.text: They apply overwhelming physical force to override a self-sustaining harmonic field.
options.rationale: No external force may directly override a self-sustaining harmonic field without local choice, so force would create direct field conflict.

options.label: C
options.text: They obtain formal permission from planetary spiritual councils before any intervention.
options.rationale: The boundary is local choice inside the harmonic field, and the managers bypass it by deceptive societal choices rather than outside permission.

options.label: D
options.text: The Custodians rely entirely on Deceit and Subversion.
options.rationale: To bypass this universal law without incurring direct field conflict, the Custodians rely entirely on Deceit and Subversion so human targets voluntarily consent.

questions.hint: Think about how a parasitic entity tricks a target into giving permission.

questions.question: What does the numerical designation 322 in the Skull & Bones club specifically reference?

options.label: A
options.text: The 322nd year of the current global planetary reset cycle, and declining any account that reaches past that point.
options.rationale: Resets are periodic, but 322 names the trophy rooms built from stacked skeletal remains, not a year count inside a reset.

options.label: B
options.text: The frequency band required to hold human perception inside 3rd-density, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: A restricted 3rd-density frequency band is the perceptual enclosure, while 322 names the bone vaults of previous harvests.

options.label: C
options.text: Subterranean vaulted trophy rooms constructed from the stacked skeletal remains of harvested human populations from past resets.
options.rationale: The numerical designation 322 references subterranean vaulted trophy rooms, referred to as Cathedrals of the Dead, constructed from the stacked skeletal remains of harvested human populations from past resets.

options.label: D
options.text: The calendar date on which the Sovereign Accord was signed as a human treaty, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: The Sovereign Accord is a cosmic field law, not a dated human treaty recorded by the Skull & Bones club.

questions.hint: Consider the physical materials used to construct the secret society trophy vaults.

questions.question: How does the Usury Trap exploit an individual's own financial equity?

options.label: A
options.text: Continuous inflation quietly devalues the currency held by the public, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: Currency devaluation can accompany the system, but the trap is the information asymmetry around the borrower's own bond.

options.label: B
options.text: Personal income is taxed so public infrastructure projects can be funded, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: The trap is the lending of pre-existing bond credit at interest, not a general tax for public works.

options.label: C
options.text: Banks seize collateral whenever a high-interest credit card falls into default, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: Seizure can follow default, but the deception is that the lent capital was already the borrower's own bond equity.

options.label: D
options.text: Parasitic banking institutions lend an individual's own bond equity back to them while demanding interest on the loan.
options.rationale: The Usury Trap is a financial confidence trick wherein parasitic banking institutions lend an individual's own bond equity back to them while demanding interest on the loan.

questions.hint: Reflect on the source of the capital used when a bank issues a loan to a registered individual.

options.rationale: Human 2.0 is the conversion of human beings into lobotomized, cybernetic entities stripped of independent thought, spiritual awareness, and past-life recall.

questions.hint: Look for the endgame that merges the biological vessel with machine-like obedience.
